description: Scan a web page URL for accessibility issues and get a CSV report. For a mobile app, run it on App Automate with accessibility on (setupBrowserStackAppAutomateTests), then fetchAccessibilityIssues.

advancedRules.description: Run the advanced accessibility rules (default true).

authConfigId.description: Optional auth config ID for authenticated scans

needsReview.description: Also report "needs review" issues to check by hand (default true).

pageURL.description: The web page URL to scan for accessibility issues

wcagVersion.description: WCAG version and level to check against, e.g. "wcag22aa", or "rgaa41" for RGAA 4.1 (default "wcag21aa").

name: startAccessibilityScan
